nodes.label: Cinematic UI Design System
nodes.rationale: Brand tone is professional, premium, high-impact, artistic — expressed as modern cinematic visuals, immersive depth, glassmorphism and sophisticated motion.

nodes.label: Brand Color Palette (Cinematic Black / Aloe Green / Vibrant Emerald)
nodes.norm_label: brand color palette (cinematic black / aloe green / vibrant emerald)

nodes.label: HP Latex Multi-Product Rows (digital_details_json.rows)
nodes.rationale: Old shape (single running_meters + shared materials_json checkboxes) could not price multiple HP Latex products per jobcard; back-compat synthesises one row from the old shape so existing jobcards still price.

nodes.label: Quote Number & PO Number Header Fields
nodes.norm_label: quote number & po number header fields

nodes.label: Artwork Department Charge (hours x rate, default R250)
nodes.rationale: Client-locked decision: artwork charge auto-adds to the invoice total rather than being typed manually.
nodes.norm_label: artwork department charge (hours x rate, default r250)

nodes.label: HP Latex Priced Material List (settings.hp_latex_materials)
nodes.rationale: Prices move from a hardcoded MATERIALS const into the settings table so the client can edit them; materials_json storage stays unchanged to keep saved jobcards working.

nodes.label: Shop Products DB CRUD (products table)
nodes.rationale: Client-locked decision: shop products live in a database table instead of lib/data.ts; lib/data.ts keeps only types and pure helpers.

nodes.label: Auto Invoice Line Sync (_auto marker upsert)
nodes.rationale: One synced line item per department identified by a stable _auto marker keeps department inputs and the invoice grid consistent while leaving manual lines editable.
nodes.norm_label: auto invoice line sync (_auto marker upsert)

nodes.label: Authoritative Setup-Route Pattern (idempotent CREATE TABLE GET routes)
nodes.rationale: Every table is owned by one idempotent GET setup route (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS) that can be re-run safely — schema changes go there, then the route is hit once.
nodes.norm_label: authoritative setup-route pattern (idempotent create table get routes)

nodes.label: Supabase app_metadata Role Model
nodes.rationale: Roles/short codes/must_change_password live in Supabase Auth app_metadata instead of a profiles table so Edge middleware can gate without a DB call and role changes take effect immediately.

nodes.label: Five Staff Accounts (ADB=admin; admin@ email is AB, a user)
nodes.rationale: admin@aloesigns.co.za belongs to Anushka Bezuidenhout (AB), a normal user — admin must never be inferred from the email prefix; Andre (andre@) is the only admin.
nodes.norm_label: five staff accounts (adb=admin; admin@ email is ab, a user)

nodes.label: Reel Render Station (Render-Reels.bat pipeline)
nodes.rationale: Staff upload clips from any PC; a double-clickable bat on the render station turns them into cinematic reels and publishes them — no command line, no monthly hosting cost.

nodes.label: Music Rotation Policy (exclude last 9 tracks, .used.json history)
nodes.norm_label: music rotation policy (exclude last 9 tracks, .used.json history)

nodes.label: Supabase Media Hosting via Signed URLs
nodes.rationale: Vercel caps API bodies at ~4.5MB, so clips upload straight to Supabase via signed URLs and reels are always hosted, never pushed through the app; raw media is git-ignored.
nodes.norm_label: supabase media hosting via signed urls
